**Triage: lands in `.github/prompts/component.prompt.md` (+ the `check:prompt-keys` gate's scope) ⇒ `domain:devx`; `Bug`; `priority:p2`; `pm:queue`.**

分诊席 · `session_017VGfRocA8VjczSe84fgjY3` · R+177 · 2026-09-11T02:2xZ · 本评论来自分诊座位. objectui `origin/main` @ `3b583628be564cdfa52ac2f24111f1e4c1e42abb`.

### Why `Bug`

The file states a registry fact — 「Required Library」, 「Required Components」, 「Standard Components Library」 — and the registry does not have those keys. The card measured it against the shared derivation (`deriveRegistryKeys`) partitioned into *registered by a non-placeholder site* vs *only `PROTOCOL_COMPONENTS`*, which is the instrument that answers the question asked. ⇒ declared ≠ enforced on an authoring surface. `Bug`.

### ⚠️ Same-file serialisation — **#8929 is IN FLIGHT on this exact file**

**objectui#8929** (`domain:devx`, **`pm:dispatched`**, p2 — *"teaches the retired `view:kanban` / `view:gantt` keys"*) edits `.github/prompts/component.prompt.md`, and so does this card.

⇒ 「同文件单跨轮硬串行」 — ⛔ do not dispatch this concurrently with #8929. It goes **after**. ⚠️ Recording it at the moment of deferral, per 「延后不是搁置,被延后那一刻就把已知的坑记到该 issue 上」.

⭐ And the ordering is cheap here, because this card's own argument depends on #8929's landed gate: the round that takes this one should read what `pnpm check:prompt-keys` ended up judging before deciding how to widen it.

### ⭐ The durable half is the gate's scope, ⛔ not the five sections

The card's own distinction is the important one and this seat upholds it: objectui#8929's bullets are labelled **Keys** — a claim about the registry — and the gate it landed judges **exactly those bullets**. The five sections in this card are labelled 「Required Types」 / 「Required Components」 / 「Required Library」 / 「Standard Components Library」, so the gate does not see them.

⇒ ⚠️ **Fixing the five section bodies without widening the gate buys nothing durable** — the same drift returns on the next retirement, and the file is read by every AI that opens this repo. ⇒ the deliverable is **both**: correct the text **and** bring these sections inside `check:prompt-keys`.

⚠️ ⛔ But the gate widening needs a judgement the round must state rather than assume: a section labelled 「Required Library」 is prose that happens to contain backticked tokens, and a gate that judges **every** backticked namespaced token in the file may fire on legitimate prose (a tombstone reference, a "do not write this" example). ⇒ the PR says what its token-selection rule is and why, ⛔ not just that the gate got wider.

### The three verdict classes, kept distinct — ⛔ do not flatten them

The card separates three different wrongnesses and the fix must keep them apart:

| class | example | the honest correction |
|---|---|---|
| **nothing registers it** | the six `atom:*` | remove, or say plainly it is not available |
| **deliberately unregistered** | `ai:chat_window` — the placeholder module's own comment records the omission as intentional, so naming it produces the loud OBJUI-001 panel | ⛔ do not "fix" by registering it; the loud panel is the designed behaviour |
| **retired** | `user:profile` — dropped from `PageComponentType` in `@objectstack/spec` 17.3.0, removed across all three sites by objectui#7122 | remove, and ⛔ never as a suggestion |
| **placeholder-only** | `ai:input`, `ai:suggestion`, `ai:feedback`, `nav:breadcrumb` | label as protocol placeholders, ⛔ not as a library an author may reach for |

⇒ ⛔ A single pass that deletes all of them is wrong: the placeholder-only set is real protocol surface and `ai:chat_window`'s absence is a designed loud failure.

⚠️ ⭐ **Cross-repo note worth carrying:** `user:profile` is the same retired type that objectstack#17595 (graded this round, `domain:spec`) is about on the lint side. ⇒ two repos are independently telling authors about a type that was retired in 17.3.0. ⛔ Not a coupling and ⛔ not a blocker — recorded so the pair is visible.

### Why p2

⛔ Not p1: nothing at runtime is broken; a key written from this file renders the loud OBJUI-001 panel or nothing, which is visible rather than silent.
⛔ Not p3: this file's entire purpose is to be read by an AI author as the authoritative key list, and it is currently wrong in **five** places outside the one gate that guards it. ⇒ the defect class is 「AI 照着仓里的说明书写出运行时不接受的元数据」, which is the expensive direction.

### Dedupe — run 2026-09-11T02:2xZ, 436-issue open `objectui` board

| pattern | open hits |
|---|---|
| `component\.prompt\.md` | **2** — #9098, #8929 |
| `check:prompt-keys` | **1** — #9098 |
| `deriveRegistryKeys` | **1** — #9098 |
| `prompt` (control) | **9** |

⛔ **No duplicate.** **#8929** is the parent and is **in flight** — different keys (`view:kanban` / `view:gantt`), different sections, same file. ⚠️ It is the serialisation partner above, ⛔ not a duplicate: this card exists precisely because #8929's gate does not reach these sections.

`Size/model suggestion:` S–M — the text corrections are S; the gate-scope widening and its token-selection rule are the part that earns the M.

### And the premise re-check comes back confirming the card

The landed gate is `scripts/check-prompt-component-keys.mjs` (`pnpm check:prompt-keys`), and its anchor is:

⇒ The deliverable stated in the grading is unchanged and now precisely sized: correct the five section bodies **and** bring them inside `check-prompt-component-keys.mjs`. ⚠️ The token-selection judgement still has to be written into the PR body — the landed gate deliberately reads one line per bullet, and these sections are prose, so widening it needs a stated rule rather than a wider regex.

All readings on `origin/main` = `1e0e46af9`. Serialisation is clear: objectui#8929 landed (`a92eef266`), and ⛔ no other in-flight PR from this seat touches `.github/prompts/**`.

## ⭐ ⛔ TWO of this card's premises do not survive measurement — read these before planning

### 1. ⛔ 「adding a label to the set it scans is a one-line change」 is FALSE

The card's Suggested shape says the gate widening is one line. It is not, and the reason is structural.

`check-prompt-component-keys.mjs` anchors on:

```js
const KEYS_BULLET = /^\s*[*-]\s+\*\*Keys:\*\*\s*(.*)$/;
```

and its own header states the rule that excludes these sections — 「Read from the `**Keys:**` **LINE only**, never from the bullet's continuation **or its sub-bullets**」.

⚠️ **That is exactly the shape difference.** A `Keys:` bullet puts every key on ONE line:

```
*   **Keys:** `view:grid`, `object-kanban`, `view:map`, `view:calendar`, `object-gantt`, etc.
```

The sections this card names put **one key per SUB-BULLET, each with prose**:

```
*   **Required Library:**
    *   `atom:icon` (Lucide Wrapper).
    *   `atom:button` (Standard Actions).
```

⇒ ⭐ **widening the gate to these sections is a change to its READING MODEL, ⛔ not to a label set.** Triage half-caught this (「needs a stated rule rather than a wider regex」); this is the mechanical reason. ⇒ the PR states its token-selection rule **and** what happens to the bullet's trailing prose.

### 2. ⛔ `Required Types` is ALREADY disambiguated — and widening the gate to it would be WRONG

The card's prose says the five sections are labelled 「**Required Types** / Required Components / Required Library / Standard Components Library」. ⚠️ But its own **table has no `Required Types` row** — every measured defect sits in the other three labels.

And objectui#8929 landed the answer for that label, in the file itself:

> ⚠️ **A `Keys` entry is a REGISTRY key; a `Required Types` entry is a spec `type` value. They are not the same vocabulary and they have diverged.**

⇒ ⛔ **`Required Types` is a spec `type` vocabulary, deliberately not a registry key list.** Pulling it into a registry-key gate would red on `grid`, `kanban`, `gantt` — values that are spec-valid by design. ⛔ Do not. ⭐ Say so in the PR, because the card's label list invites exactly that mistake.

## Premises — ⛔ each is yours to re-run

| reading | value on `1e0e46af9` |
|:--|--:|
| `**Keys:**` bullets in the file | **2** |
| `Required Types:` sections | **3** — ⛔ out of scope, see above |
| `Standard Components Library:` sections | **1** |
| `Required Library:` sections | **1** |
| `Required Components:` sections | **2** — ⚠️ see below |
| each disputed token's occurrences | **1** each (`atom:icon`, `atom:button`, `ai:chat_window`, `ai:input`, `nav:breadcrumb`, `user:profile`) |

⚠️ **There are TWO `Required Components:` sections and the card only measures one.** The other is section G's `action:*` list — `action:button`, `action:group`, `action:menu`, `action:icon` — which the card does **not** flag. ⇒ a label-based widening pulls it in too. ⛔ Do not assume it is clean: **partition those four through `deriveRegistryKeys` like the rest** and report the verdict. If they are clean that is a free non-vacuity datum; if one is not, it is a sixth site the card missed.

## ⛔ The three-plus-one verdict classes — ⛔ do not flatten them

Triage's table, upheld here:

| class | example | the honest correction |
|---|---|---|
| **nothing registers it** | the six `atom:*` | remove, or say plainly it is not available |
| **deliberately unregistered** | `ai:chat_window` — the placeholder module's own comment records the omission as intentional so a page schema naming it draws the loud OBJUI-001 panel | ⛔ **do not「fix」by registering it.** The loud panel is the designed behaviour |
| **retired** | `user:profile` — dropped from `PageComponentType` in `@objectstack/spec` 17.3.0, removed across all three sites by objectui#7122 | remove, and ⛔ never as a suggestion |
| **placeholder-only** | `ai:input`, `ai:suggestion`, `ai:feedback`, `nav:breadcrumb` | label as protocol placeholders, ⛔ not as a library an author may reach for |

⇒ ⛔ **A single pass that deletes all of them is wrong.**

## ⚠️ The roadmap-or-vocabulary decision is YOURS, and it is per section

The card puts it squarely: read as a ROADMAP, `atom:*` is correct and nothing needs fixing; read as a REGISTRY VOCABULARY, an AI reaching for `atom:button` gets the unknown-type panel.

⇒ ⭐ **decide per section, with the measurement that decides it, and write the decision into the file** so the next reader does not have to guess. ⛔ A section left ambiguous after this card is the card not done. ⚠️ A section ruled ROADMAP stays **outside** the gate — and then say so **in the section**, ⛔ not only in the PR body.

## ⛔ Fences

- ⛔ `.github/prompts/**` is ⛔ **not** the governed surface (`.claude/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`) — ⛔ do not touch those.
- ⛔ Do not register anything. This card moves **documentation and one gate**; ⛔ a new registration is a different card.
- ⛔ Do not re-open objectui#8929's two `Keys:` bullets. They are correct and gated.
- ⚠️ objectstack#17595 is about the same retired `user:profile` on the lint side, in the **other repo**. ⛔ Not a coupling, ⛔ not a blocker, ⛔ not yours.
